description: Conservative model-specific reasoning overrides for the vLLM inference catalog. Exact model IDs only; do not propagate to quantizations or derivatives.

openai/gpt-oss-20b.note: The gpt-oss open-weight models have three trained reasoning levels. The none value is not included.

openai/gpt-oss-120b.note: The gpt-oss open-weight models have three trained reasoning levels. The none value is not included.

deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash.note: vLLM DeepSeek V4 maps none to chat mode, low to low, high to high, and max to max. Minimal/medium alias low and are omitted from the distinct level list.

deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro.note: vLLM DeepSeek V4 maps none to chat mode, low to low, high to high, and max to max. Minimal/medium alias low and are omitted from the distinct level list.

Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B.note: vLLM thinking_token_budget is a numerical per-request reasoning token ceiling, not reasoning_effort. Requires a supported reasoning parser; effective range also depends on generation limits.
